title: 01 · Pulse stroke  (r03)
idea: A single 76 px round-capped violet-to-cyan stroke traces r03's pulse: flat lead-in, tall asymmetric crest, deep narrow trough, and a raised tail.

title: 02 · K pulse stroke  (r03)
idea: A vertical stem plus one continuous 76px round-capped wave that crests at the upper right, folds into a tight 46px-radius U-turn on the stem, and troughs to the lower right.

title: 03 · Loop ribbon s  (r05)
idea: A single 68-wide round-capped ribbon with a small lower-left loop, two rising crests and a long descending right leg, one self-crossing with the covered pass drawn darker and translucent, and a horizontal mint to aqua to sky to azure to violet gradient.

title: 04 · Loop ribbon k  (r05)
idea: A free-standing cursive k made of 84 px round-capped r05-style ribbon: a straight stem, plus one ribbon that swoops from the upper right, loops against the stem and crosses itself, then leaves as a gently waving leg.

title: 05 · Liquid pulse  (r06)
idea: A single white filled liquid pulse, five forward-leaning teardrop peaks rising to the fourth and falling, pinched necks, rounded drips below the baseline, soft-pointed lead-in and tail, with a butter-yellow dot beside the tallest peak as the word being read.

title: 06 · Bone wave  (r07)
idea: One plump white dog-bone blob slanted -8 degrees on an ink tile, with four soft corner lobes (two on each end, separated by shallow dimples), a top edge with two crests and a pinched waist, and a bottom edge that mirrors it, so it reads as a single spoken wave segment like r07.

title: 07 · Liquid k  (r06 r07)
idea: A bold white K built as a smooth-unioned sound-pulse stem (swelling about 1.6x with concave flanks) plus drop-tapered arm and leg that fuse through a rounded fillet, with a butter-yellow dot as the word being read, echoing the r06 and r07 liquid white forms.

title: 08 · Sparkle voice  (r01 r04)
idea: A concave four-point sparkle (r01) whose right tip pokes into the first of three decreasing ellipse bars (r04), cut with a hairline gap, all in one mint-white-lilac-sky gradient, so the sparkle reads as a voice emitting sound.

title: 09 · Sparkle bars white  (r04)
idea: A white four-point sparkle plus three descending lens bars, with the sparkle cut at the first bar by a hairline gap and a pointed notch, on a blue squircle with a soft diagonal fold.

title: 10 · Sparkle wave  (r01)
idea: A four-point iridescent sparkle in r01's style with straight needle verticals and horizontal arms bent by an odd sine (left dips into a trough, right rises into a crest), so the star reads as a sound wave passing through it, like a speech waveform in a sparkle.

title: 11 · Wave prism  (r09)
idea: r09's soft white pyramid on a dark tile, with the gradient facet's right edge turned into a smooth S-wave so sound flows down the object.

title: 12 · Kit cube wave  (r11)
idea: An r11-style white rounded-hexagon cube outline whose glossy aqua-to-violet top face is a tilted sound-wave lid, with upper and lower edges forming in-phase S-waves and a soft white highlight across its upper half.

title: 13 · Iso wave modules  (r08)
idea: Five shared-wall isometric prisms with heights 0.8/1.8/3/1.8/0.8 form a sound-wave envelope out of kit pieces, in r08's monoline hex-module style, and the tallest module's top face is the yellow word being read.

title: 14 · Hex wave cut  (r11 r08)
idea: A solid rounded pointy-top hexagon (kit module) in an azure to sky to aqua gradient, with a smooth sine band cut out as negative space that runs left to right and opens through the right edge, with a butter-yellow dot on the second crest as the word being read.

title: 15 · Window wave  (r10)
idea: A white tile holds a dark superellipse window containing a plump white sound-swell lens with a tall crest and a smaller second crest, lit by a blue glow rising from the window floor, as in r10's bubble-in-window.

title: 16 · Window k  (r10)
idea: A plump white liquid K (pulse-swelling stem, tapered round-ended arm and leg) glowing inside r10's dark superellipse window on a white tile, with a blue glow rising from the window bottom, tying K for SpeakKit to the r10 bubble-in-window construction.

title: 17 · Scallop kit  (r02)
idea: A white r02-style app tile holding four flat wavy kit modules (yellow 8-point star, blue 10-scallop disc carrying a white sine voice stroke, lilac 10-petal flower, mint 5-lobe clover), all generated mathematically so scallops are even and symmetric.

title: 18 · Jelly wave  (r02)
idea: A plump translucent azure jelly sine ribbon with one tall and one small crest sits on r02's very light jelly tile, with a soft highlight band, darker lower shade and a contact shadow, so the voice-wave reads as the same soft clay material as r02's jelly letters.

title: 19 · K crest tile  (r03)
idea: A white monoline K on a violet-blue-cyan tile, where the arm and leg are one wave stroke (crest, rounded turn kissing the stem, trough), carrying r03's pulse stroke into the letter.

title: 20 · Echo k  (r03 r05)
idea: A K made of three parallel monoline echoes (stem plus a wavy arm/leg curve, each offset exactly 52 px along the curve normal) with the r03 violet-blue-cyan gradient lightening outward, so the K reads as a vibrating sound ripple.
